description: This file contains static functions for printing test results in different protocols (CLAP and TAP) for the clar testing framework. It includes functions for initializing, shutting down, reporting errors, and outputting test and suite statuses, with support for different verbosity levels and output formats.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_init
methods.description: Prints initialization message for CLAP protocol, indicating loaded test suites.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_shutdown
methods.description: Prints shutdown message for CLAP protocol and reports all results.

methods.name: clar_print_indented
methods.description: Prints a string with indentation, handling multi-line strings.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_error
methods.description: Outputs a failure report with suite, test, file, and line information.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_ontest
methods.description: Outputs test status in CLAP format based on verbosity.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_onsuite
methods.description: Outputs suite start message in CLAP format.

methods.name: clar_print_clap_onabort
methods.description: Outputs an abort message in CLAP format.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_shutdown
methods.description: Prints TAP protocol shutdown message with total test count.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_error
methods.description: Placeholder for TAP error reporting (empty implementation).

methods.name: print_escaped
methods.description: Escapes single quotes in a string for TAP output.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_ontest
methods.description: Outputs test result in TAP format, including detailed error info if failed.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_onsuite
methods.description: Outputs suite start message in TAP format.

methods.name: clar_print_tap_onabort
methods.description: Outputs a bailout message in TAP format.

methods.name: clar_print_onabortv
methods.description: Dispatches abort message based on output format.

methods.name: clar_print_onabort
methods.description: Variadic function to output abort message.
